Based on my exploration of this checkout:

- The duplication helper is `clone` in `sklearn/base.py:46`, which delegates to `_clone_parametrized` (`sklearn/base.py:100`). That helper reads config via `estimator.get_params(deep=False)` (`sklearn/base.py:127`) and reconstructs `klass(**new_object_params)` (`sklearn/base.py:131`), so fitted attributes are dropped.
- The mixin that defines how an estimator reports its configuration is `BaseEstimator` (`sklearn/base.py:165`), which defines `get_params` (`sklearn/base.py:248`) and `_get_param_names` (`sklearn/base.py:219`), plus `__sklearn_clone__` (`sklearn/base.py:444`).
